summary: Join our Ethical Dilemmas in Auditing and Governance Training Course. Gain insights into ethical decision-making and strengthen your auditing expertise today.
lede: Ethics in auditing and governance training helps auditors, board members, and governance professionals assess difficult choices in assurance and oversight. Participants learn to recognize ethical risks, manage conflicts of interest and pressure to change findings, and apply structured decision-making frameworks to weigh stakeholder impacts and document their reasoning.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for professionals who regularly face ethical choices in auditing, oversight, and governance roles.
audience: Audit managers and heads of internal audit
Audit committee and risk committee members
Company secretaries and corporate governance officers
Public sector oversight and supreme audit institution
modules: Foundations of Ethics in Auditing and Governance
Independence, Objectivity, and Conflicts of Interest
Building and Sustaining an Ethical Culture
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of auditing and governance principles. Prior experience in auditing, compliance, or governance roles is recommended.
